name: hilbana
description: Everything Hilbana for Claude Code in one install: persistent per-project agent memory (an engram replacement, with hooks that load context on open and save a summary on close) + the human+agent workflow framework (pull queue and the cycle commands /hilbana-claim-next, /hilbana-finish, /hilbana-plan, /hilbana-review) + Hilbana's MCP server auto-registered. Commands and skills are written in Spanish.

api_key.title: Hilbana API key
api_key.description: Create it under Settings → API keys in the workspace you work in (format hil_…). The tools and the memory operate on THAT key's workspace, so use a key from the right one.

base_url.title: Hilbana URL
base_url.description: Base URL of your deployment, without /mcp.
